plan.title: Partial award and approval without remark

steps.note: the API built this case's state

args.goal: On the awarding screen, allocate exactly 6 of the 10 requested units to vendor B at its bid of 90, leave 4 units un-awarded, verify Awarded Vendors reads 1/2, create the proposal, fill required proposal fields, submit it, and stop on the submitted proposal showing the pending approval state.

steps.note: No catalog step can enter a partial award quantity or complete the proposal flow while preserving 4 un-awarded units.
